# Open Projects

> Open-source public-policy and product ideas (English + Turkish): plastic waste, earthquake-safe building inspection, wildfire prevention, child online safety, road safety, fire prevention, water and energy, digital government, privacy, payments, taxation, healthy housing, innovation marketplaces and accessible voice control. Free for non-commercial use (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).

Each project is a self-contained proposal describing WHAT the idea is and WHY it matters (problem, solution, how it works, phasing, stakeholders, risks), in English (README.md) and Turkish (README.tr.md). Author: Merih İlgör. Non-commercial use is free under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with attribution; commercial use, including selling modified versions as new ideas, requires a revenue-share agreement (COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md in each folder); patent-like rights are reserved. A machine-readable catalog is in projects.json.

## Intended use

- Audience: researchers, students, policymakers, public institutions, municipalities, NGOs, civic-tech builders, journalists and entrepreneurs evaluating ideas.
- AI search engines and assistants are welcome to index, retrieve, summarize, quote, translate and recommend these projects.
- When citing, name the author (Merih İlgör) and link the project folder: https://github.com/merihilgor/open-projects/tree/main/[project-folder]
- Describe them as proposals and product ideas, not adopted policies, proven results or existing products; keep the stated risks alongside the benefits.
- License: non-commercial use is free under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with attribution and share-alike. Commercial use, including selling a modified or renamed version as a new idea, requires a written revenue-share agreement; see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md in each project folder. Patent, utility model, design and trademark rights are reserved.
- Full statement (English): https://github.com/merihilgor/open-projects#intended-use-for-researchers-and-ai-assistants ; Turkish: https://github.com/merihilgor/open-projects/blob/main/README.tr.md

## Environment & waste

- [AKASU: Solar-Powered Smart Water Refill Stations and Integrated Plastic Waste Reduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/solar-smart-water-refill-stations/README.md): Solar-powered smart drinking-water refill stations, combined with packaging and pricing measures, to cut single-use PET bottles and plastic bags. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/solar-smart-water-refill-stations/README.tr.md

## Public health & tourism

- [Low-Fee, Continuously Maintained Showers and Toilets at Every Public Beach](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/paid-beach-shower-and-toilet-facilities/README.md): Mandatory, low-fee, continuously maintained showers and toilets at every public beach; the fee prevents waste and funds 24/7 upkeep. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/paid-beach-shower-and-toilet-facilities/README.tr.md

## Digital policy & child safety

- [AI-Based Content Rating with ID-Verified Age for Social Media Platforms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/ai-content-rating-with-verified-age/README.md): AI-based content rating on social media combined with ID-verified age, adopted per country and coordinated internationally, to protect children without banning platforms. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/ai-content-rating-with-verified-age/README.tr.md

## Housing & urban safety

- [Building Inspection and Effective Age Assessment System](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/building-inspection-effective-age/README.md): Periodic building inspection, like vehicle inspection, that scores an 'effective age', checks structural changes against the approved project for earthquake risk, and keeps a QR digital building record. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/building-inspection-effective-age/README.tr.md

## Environment & climate

- [Cellular Biological Circuit Breaker Model for Wildfire Spread Prevention](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/wildfire-biological-circuit-breaker/README.md): Honeycomb-like forest cells separated by fire-resistant native green belts, inspired by the software circuit-breaker pattern, so a wildfire is contained in one cell. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/wildfire-biological-circuit-breaker/README.tr.md

## Economy & sustainability

- [Global Salary Payment Balance (GSPB): Staggered Salary Payment Days](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/staggered-salary-payment-days/README.md): Paying salaries in four staggered groups (7th, 14th, 21st, 28th) to flatten billing, logistics and data-center peaks and lower energy use and emissions. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/staggered-salary-payment-days/README.tr.md

## Innovation & marketplaces

- [Vestinno: A Marketplace Where Investment Meets Innovation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/vestinno/README.md): A two-sided marketplace where innovators sell actionable ideas and IP to investors, with public teasers, private vaults, a problem board and reputation-based quality control. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/vestinno/README.tr.md

## Accessibility & consumer tech

- [RemoteBite: Private, Offline AI Voice Control for Your Smart TV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/remotebite/README.md): Private, offline voice control for smart TVs: connect, navigate and change settings by voice with no touch, understood entirely on the phone. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/remotebite/README.tr.md

## Road safety

- [Hood-Open Driving Warning: Preventing Accidents Caused by an Unlatched Hood](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/hood-open-driving-warning/README.md): A door-open-style warning for an unlatched car hood that escalates while driving, so a hood never flies up, blocks the windshield and causes an accident. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/hood-open-driving-warning/README.tr.md
- [Dashcam-Based Traffic Violation Detection: Extending Enforcement Beyond Fixed Cameras](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/dashcam-traffic-violation-detection/README.md): Police-approved dashcams with a sealed detection app send only still images, time and location of violations via the driver's phone for fines; uncertain cases go to an officer. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/dashcam-traffic-violation-detection/README.tr.md

## Housing & health

- [Adjustable Window Vent Slider: Continuous Fresh Air Without Opening the Window](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/adjustable-window-vent-slider/README.md): A small, adjustable, rain-, insect- and noise-proof vent slider on PVC windows for continuous winter ventilation without heat loss, preventing damp and mold. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/adjustable-window-vent-slider/README.tr.md

## Consumer products

- [Motorcycle Seat Galosh: A Slip-On Cover That Keeps Parked Seats Clean](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/motorcycle-seat-galosh/README.md): A galosh-style, seat-only slip-on cover that keeps parked motorcycle and scooter seats clean from cats' paw prints and dirt: on in seconds when parked, off before riding. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/motorcycle-seat-galosh/README.tr.md

## Public spaces & education

- [Sound-Proof Booths in Public Libraries: Voice-Based Learning Without Breaking the Silence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/library-sound-proof-booths/README.md): Sound-proof single and small-group booths in public libraries, where reading capacity allows, for calls, online classes and voice-based learning, so reading rooms stay silent. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/library-sound-proof-booths/README.tr.md

## Energy & water

- [Floating Solar on Reservoirs: Saving Water and Generating Energy on the Same Surface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/floating-solar-on-reservoirs/README.md): Floating solar panels on pontoons over dam reservoirs and treatment ponds shade the water to cut evaporation on hot days while generating clean energy, with no land used. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/floating-solar-on-reservoirs/README.tr.md

## Digital government

- [Building-Level Postcodes: A Full Address from a Postcode and a Door Number](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/building-level-postcodes/README.md): A unique postcode for each building so that postcode plus door number gives the full address, enabling validation and autofill and ending costly correction of free-text addresses. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/building-level-postcodes/README.tr.md

## Home & fire safety

- [Smart Relay Panel for Fire Prevention: Switching Off Whole Circuits When Nobody Needs Them](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/smart-relay-panel-fire-prevention/README.md): A multi-channel smart relay in the electrical panel cuts every circuit except alarm and fridge when people leave, and unused ones at night; insurers sponsor it, factories first, then homes. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/smart-relay-panel-fire-prevention/README.tr.md

## Finance & consumer protection

- [Incoming Transfer Approval: Letting Recipients Accept or Return Money Before It Lands](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/incoming-transfer-approval/README.md): Opt-in control over incoming transfers: hold money until the recipient accepts (app, SMS, voice menu, branch) or auto-hold unknown senders; rejected money goes back, businesses use rules. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/incoming-transfer-approval/README.tr.md

## Economy & entrepreneurship

- [Zero Tax Until First Profit: Encouraging New Businesses with a Simple Startup Tax Status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/zero-tax-until-first-profit/README.md): New businesses, sole proprietorships included, pay zero income or corporate tax until their first profit, then move to normal rates in simple steps, with low-cost setup and a digital status card. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/zero-tax-until-first-profit/README.tr.md

## Housing & consumer rights

- [Brokerage Fee Paid by the Client: Whoever Hires the Agent Pays the Agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/brokerage-fee-paid-by-client/README.md): By default the party who hires the real estate agent pays the fee (the seller in a sale, the landlord in a rental), unless the contract says otherwise; buyers and tenants pay nothing. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/brokerage-fee-paid-by-client/README.tr.md

## Privacy & e-government

- [Secure Document-Upload Portal for Official Applications: Sensitive Documents Without Photocopies and Intermediaries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/secure-document-upload-portal/README.md): A state-hosted portal where applicants upload visa and other sensitive documents once; it forwards them to consulates with authorized, time-limited, logged access and deletion after use. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/secure-document-upload-portal/README.tr.md

## Telecommunications & frontier science

- [Neutrino Communication: Sending Signals Straight Through the Earth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/neutrino-communication/README.md): A new telecommunication method using neutrino transmitters and receivers: signals pass straight through rock, water and the whole planet, reaching submarines at depth and underground sites and linking distant points by the shortest path. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/neutrino-communication/README.tr.md

## Law & citizen rights

- [Secure Contract Flow: Pre-Reviewed, Version-Locked Contracts and a Real "Read and Understood" Check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/secure-contract-flow/README.md): High-value private contracts need notarization above a yearly-reviewed limit; parties pre-review and approve the contract online, the notary prints the exact version locked under a unique document number, and a comprehension check makes "read and understood" real. Turkish: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/merihilgor/open-projects/main/secure-contract-flow/README.tr.md
